def parser(log: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    import re
    from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

    results: dict[str, str] = {}

    # Strip ANSI escape sequences (colors, cursor movement, etc.)
    re_ansi = re.compile(r"\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]")

    def norm_status(raw: str) -> str | None:
        s = raw.strip().lower()
        if s in {"ok", "pass", "passed", "success", "successful", "bench"}:
            return "pass"
        if s in {"ignored", "skip", "skipped", "not run", "xfailed", "xfail"}:
            return "skip"
        if s in {"failed", "fail", "error", "errored", "panic", "xpass", "timeout"}:
            return "fail"
        return None

    def update(name: str, status: str) -> None:
        # If duplicates occur, keep the worst outcome.
        priority = {"pass": 0, "skip": 1, "fail": 2}
        name = name.strip()
        if not name:
            return
        prev = results.get(name)
        if prev is None or priority[status] > priority[prev]:
            results[name] = status

    lines = log.splitlines()

    # --- JUnit XML (if present inline) ---
    xml_blocks: list[str] = []
    start = None
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if start is None and "<testsuite" in line:
            start = i
        if start is not None and "</testsuite>" in line:
            xml_blocks.append("\n".join(lines[start : i + 1]))
            start = None

    for block in xml_blocks:
        try:
            root = ET.fromstring(block.strip())
        except Exception:
            continue
        for tc in root.iter():
            if tc.tag.split("}", 1)[-1] != "testcase":
                continue
            classname = (tc.attrib.get("classname") or "").strip()
            name = (tc.attrib.get("name") or "").strip()
            full = f"{classname}::{name}" if classname and name else (name or classname)
            if not full:
                continue
            status = "pass"
            for child in list(tc):
                tag = child.tag.split("}", 1)[-1]
                if tag in {"failure", "error"}:
                    status = "fail"
                    break
                if tag == "skipped":
                    status = "skip"
            update(full, status)

    # --- Line-based formats ---
    # Rust libtest/cargo:
    # test name ... ok
    # test name ... FAILED
    # test name ... ignored
    # sometimes no space: `...ok`
    # sometimes extra annotations: `... ok (some info)`
    re_rust = re.compile(
        r"^\s*test\s+(?P<name>.+?)\s+\.\.\.\s*(?P<status>ok|failed|ignored|bench|timeout)\b.*$",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )

    # pytest:
    re_pytest = re.compile(
        r"^(?P<name>\S+?)\s+(?P<status>PASSED|FAILED|SKIPPED|XFAIL|XPASS|ERROR)\s*$"
    )

    # unittest:
    re_unittest = re.compile(
        r"^(?P<name>.+?)\s+\.\.\.\s+(?P<status>ok|FAIL|ERROR|skipped)\s*$"
    )

    # go test:
    re_go = re.compile(r"^---\s+(?P<status>PASS|FAIL|SKIP):\s+(?P<name>\S+)\b")

    # nextest:
    re_nextest = re.compile(
        r"^\s*(?P<status>PASS|FAIL|SKIP)\s+\[[^\]]*\]\s+(?P<name>.+?)\s*$"
    )

    # jest:
    re_jest_symbol = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<sym>[✓✕○])\s+(?P<name>.+?)\s*$")
    re_jest_word = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<status>PASS|FAIL)\s+(?P<name>.+?)\s*$")

    for raw_line in lines:
        line = re_ansi.sub("", raw_line)

        m = re_rust.match(line)
        if m:
            st = norm_status(m.group("status")) or "fail"
            update(m.group("name"), st)
            continue

        m = re_pytest.match(line)
        if m:
            st = norm_status(m.group("status")) or "fail"
            update(m.group("name"), st)
            continue

        m = re_unittest.match(line)
        if m:
            st = norm_status(m.group("status")) or "fail"
            update(m.group("name"), st)
            continue

        m = re_go.match(line)
        if m:
            st = norm_status(m.group("status")) or "fail"
            update(m.group("name"), st)
            continue

        m = re_nextest.match(line)
        if m:
            st = norm_status(m.group("status")) or "fail"
            update(m.group("name"), st)
            continue

        m = re_jest_symbol.match(line)
        if m:
            sym = m.group("sym")
            st = {"✓": "pass", "✕": "fail", "○": "skip"}.get(sym)
            if st:
                update(m.group("name"), st)
            continue

        m = re_jest_word.match(line)
        if m:
            st = norm_status(m.group("status")) or "fail"
            update(m.group("name"), st)
            continue

    return results
